redCandidate.setup: Create an external sentinel file, create a file symlink to it under a temporary workspace docs/ directory, then declare that apparently in-workspace path as required context in a structured plan.
redCandidate.expected: The linked ref is invalid_ref, has no accepted source hash, and cannot contribute external text to assembled runtime context.
redCandidate.observed: The direct packet reported the external symlink source exists=true, proving the lexical resolver allowed a physical external file to be read.
redCandidate.failureReason: resolveLocalRef validates only lexical path containment while inspectSource and readAssemblySource read the unresolved symlink path.
